## Workload

During 2023 Q3, grader Nadia Qureshi completed 304 reads over 465 hours. This represents a rate of 0.7 reads per hour. The workload was recorded for review by Priya Anand, who considered the volume of work alongside the time available for each session.

The review found that the current session pattern supported completion of the assigned reads. No change to the pattern was recommended.

## Quality

A sample of 19 reads was checked as part of the quality review. The agreement rate was 84.2 per cent. Priya Anand reviewed the results with Nadia Qureshi and confirmed that the findings provided a useful assessment of grading consistency.

The grader and reviewer agreed to retain the current session pattern. The workload and quality results will continue to inform routine monitoring.
